approach: Static recompilation of the game's x86 code (Freedom.Exe, 2003) to C with a project-specific recompiler, Windows / Direct3D 8 / DirectSound / DirectInput reimplemented as host code (OpenGL ES through vitaGL on PS Vita), and the hot game code decompiled into verified native C
notes: Runs on PS Vita and macOS through static recompilation; no emulator runs the game's CPU code. Hot functions (lighting, skinning, collision, culling, scene transforms) are decompiled with Ghidra and rewritten as native C, each checked against the recompiled code on the same state (native_check). Plan and progress in docs/NATIVE_PLAN.md.
